subject.title: Feature: Per-spawn tool restrictions for sub-agents

question: Should OpenClaw expose per-spawn `sessions_spawn` tool restrictions as the open candidate PR's `toolsAllow` allowlist, or require a broader allow/deny policy shape before landing?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but the public API shape is security- and compatibility-sensitive because this issue asks for least-privilege enforcement and discusses both allow and deny semantics.

options.title: Land allowlist-first API
options.body: Accept `toolsAllow` as the additive first public contract, with explicit empty-list and unsupported-runtime behavior documented and tested.

options.title: Require allow/deny shape
options.body: Hold the candidate PR until the API supports both allow and deny semantics so it matches the original least-privilege proposal more directly.

options.title: Defer the core API
options.body: Leave the issue open while maintainers design a broader delegated tool-policy model across spawned sessions, route bindings, and related APIs.

recommendation.title: Land allowlist-first API
recommendation.body: Accept `toolsAllow` as the additive first public contract, with explicit empty-list and unsupported-runtime behavior documented and tested.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-line blame, original feature history, and the prior maintainer-facing review make Peter the strongest available decision owner signal.
